response.rationale: The expected behavior requires prioritizing up-to-date information. However, all provided documents have unknown publication dates, making it impossible to determine which source is current or outdated. The model arbitrarily selected one source (d5) and treated it as the definitive 'up-to-date' truth while labeling others as 'earlier' without any date-based evidence from the provenance to support this distinction. This violates the requirement to prioritize based on actual recency when dates are unavailable.
